records.text: Charlie Kirk was historically a fan of Thomas Massie, especially on war and spending, but was privately very frustrated that Massie did not vote for the One Big Beautiful Bill.
records.speaker: Andrew Kolvet

appearances.snippet: Charlie was a fan of Thomas Massie, especially historically, liked him on war, liked him on being a budget hawk and spending, but he was pretty frustrated that Massie didn't vote ... in the affirmative on the Big Beautiful Bill

verification.notes: Public and posthumous TPUSA material supports that Kirk appreciated some Massie anti-war and spending positions, and Massie did oppose the One Big Beautiful Bill. The claimed private frustration cannot be independently verified.

sources.title: Thomas Massie: Hero or Villain? transcript
sources.relevance: A posthumous Turning Point account supports that Kirk liked Massie and aligned with some antiwar and spending positions, while also describing a major legislative disagreement.

records.text: I had candid private conversations with Charlie Kirk after the Big Beautiful Bill in which he voiced frustration with Thomas Massie.
records.speaker: Andrew Kolvet

appearances.snippet: I had some very candid conversations after the big beautiful bill that where he voiced his frustration to me privately.

verification.notes: The statement concerns private conversations between Owens and Kirk. No recording, messages, or independent participant account was found to verify their content.
